TRUST_ROOT_CUSTODIAN.question: Who may create, hold, enroll, revoke and recover an independent verification trust root?
options: Operator-controlled offline trust root with separately verified public fingerprint
Administratively managed OS-owned trust store with operator approval
TRUST_ROOT_CUSTODIAN.never: An automatically adopted public key carried inside the candidate release

SIGNER_AND_RELEASE_REVIEWER.question: Who signs the host release and who independently reviews its source, dependencies and signing evidence?
options: Separate release signer, reviewer, key custodian and final operator
Equivalent auditable separation of duties explicitly approved by operator
SIGNER_AND_RELEASE_REVIEWER.never: Self-approving release signer or this browser session claiming staff authority

APPROVED_RELEASE_CHANNEL.question: How are host/interpreter/owner-module artifacts and signed manifests delivered and pinned independently of mutable source trees?
options: Signed immutable release artifact, independently provisioned verifier trust root and content pins
Operator-approved administrator-controlled artifact distribution with equivalent provenance checks
APPROVED_RELEASE_CHANNEL.never: Import and execute from a mutable unreviewed checkout or same-user writable trust folder

ROLLBACK_RESISTANT_GENERATION.question: Where is the last accepted generation and exact release digest persisted to reject downgrade and same-generation replay?
options: Operator/admin-protected monotonic state and exact release digest
Equivalent independently authenticated version floor and release identity with rollback-resistant recovery
ROLLBACK_RESISTANT_GENERATION.never: Release directory containing its own editable minimum generation

KEY_ROTATION_AND_REVOCATION.question: What evidence authorizes replacing or revoking the signing root, and how can a lost root be recovered without silent self-enrollment?
options: Old+new-root transition proof, independent custodian/reviewer and operator approval
Offline recovery ceremony using an operator-approved independent recovery anchor
KEY_ROTATION_AND_REVOCATION.never: Unknown replacement key accepted because it signs itself

HOST_EXECUTABLE_THREAT_MODEL.question: Which attackers must be resisted: supply-chain substitution, same-user code changes, privileged root compromise, and noncooperating writers?
options: Define same-user adversary limits and root-controlled deployment boundary
Stronger isolated/sandboxed host identity and OS policy after independent security review
HOST_EXECUTABLE_THREAT_MODEL.never: Treat Ed25519, PIDFD, advisory flock or nonce as complete runtime attestation
